text.en:
1. This Act may be cited as The Titular Superior of the Brothers

of Saint Gabriel (Incorporation) Act 1957.

Interpretation

2. In this Act, unless the context otherwise requires—

"Corporation" means The Titular Superior of the Brothers

of Saint Gabriel, Peninsular Malaysia as incorporated under

section 3;

"successors in office" includes the Brother Procurator of the

Congregation of the Brothers of Christian Instruction of Saint Gabriel

in Peninsular Malaysia when the office of the Titular Superior

becomes vacant by the resignation or death of the holder of the

office of the Titular Superior until the formal assumption of

office by a successor.

Incorporation of The Titular Superior of the Brothers of

Saint Gabriel

3. (1) The Reverend Brother Vincent, the Titular Superior of the

Congregation of the Brothers of Christian Instruction of Saint

Gabriel in Peninsular Malaysia, and his successors in office, shall

be a body corporate by the name of "The Titular Superior of the

Brothers of Saint Gabriel, Peninsular Malaysia" and shall have

perpetual succession and a corporate seal.

(2) The Corporation may sue and be sued in its name.

(3) The Corporation may—

(a) enter into contracts;

(b) acquire, purchase, take, hold and enjoy movable and

immovable property of every description upon such

terms as the Corporation thinks fit; and

(c) sell, convey, assign, exchange, surrender, yield up,

mortgage, demise, reassign, transfer or otherwise

dispose of any movable or immovable property vested

in the corporation upon such terms as the corporation

thinks fit.

Common seal

4. (1) The Corporation shall have a common seal which may

be broken, changed, altered and made anew as the Corporation

thinks fit.

(2) All deeds, documents and other instruments requiring

the seal of the Corporation shall be sealed with the seal of the

Corporation in the presence of—

(a) the Titular Superior;

(b) when the office of the Titular Superior is vacant, the

Brother Procurator; or
The Titular Superior of the Brothers

of Saint Gabriel (Incorporation)

(c) the attorney of the Titular Superior or the Brother Procurator

duly authorized by a power of attorney deposited

pursuant to section 4 of the Powers of Attorney Act 1949

[Act 424].

(3) All deeds, documents and other instruments duly sealed

under subsection (2) shall be signed by the Titular Superior, the

Brother Procurator or the attorney so authorized, as the case may

be.

(4) The signing of the deed, document or other instrument

shall be sufficient evidence of the due sealing of the deed,

document or other instrument and the seal is the lawful seal of

the Corporation.

Notification of appointment of Titular Superior

5. A notification in the Gazette of the appointment of any person—

(a) to the office of the Titular Superior or Brother Procurator of

the Congregation of the Brothers of Christian Instruction

of Saint Gabriel, Peninsular Malaysia; or

(b) to officiate as such Titular Superior or Brother Procurator,

shall be conclusive evidence that such person is duly authorized

to exercise the powers conferred on the Titular Superior or the

Brother Procurator, as the case may be, under this Act.

Corporation to have office in Peninsular Malaysia

6. (1) The Corporation shall have an office in Peninsular Malaysia.

(2) The address of the office and any subsequent change of

address shall be notified to the Secretary to the Minister who is

responsible for social welfare, and particulars of the address shall

be published in the Gazette.
